content: MDN documents that EventSource reconnects by default when the connection closes, emits error events for network failures, and treats colon-prefixed comments as ignored stream data that can keep a connection alive. The project sends a 25-second comment ping and reconnects with client-side exponential full jitter, so a five-minute closure is not explained by normal EventSource idle behavior alone; browser lifecycle, process death, or the separate long-lived /ask POST remain observable boundaries.
